scope_choices: This is automated model review, not independent human verification, independent replication, or clinical validation.
This synthesis read all 26 supplied page texts and their earlier image-review notes. It did not directly receive or inspect images. Visual coverage belongs to the supplied earlier API page calls.
Source path, hash, page count, and API receipt metadata are supplied provenance, not newly checked filesystem or API facts.

All 128 operational features receive dispositions. Additional assertions preserve observation-versus-imagination and environment-specific scopes. Comparator configurations are not comprehensively mapped.
No executable schema validation, source-binding checker, quotation matcher, graph validation, repository inspection, or filesystem write occurred in this call.
The supplied precheck identifies a malformed source_hash on e:B052:commands. Its explicit repair is logged in submission; previous candidate descriptions of a different precheck were erroneous.

L4 is supported by this paper's described model-coupled policy training and control results, not inherited from cited systems. Separate prediction fidelity, complete action-conditioned equations, alternative-action forecasts, and imagination depth remain unreported.
Episode limit 80, clutch delay 6, training sequence length 6, optimization timesteps, computation days, and approximately 1 Hz execution are distinct from predictive horizon and clinical time.

Results concern the full perception/hybrid-controller composition. NoClutch improves several simulated outcomes but performs worse on square-phantom hardware. Uniform component superiority is unsupported.
The printed grasping-score formula, stated [0,1] range, and positive Table 3 values remain inconsistent. No corrected formula or recomputed score is substituted.
The 65% headline is retained separately from square-phantom standard 75%, multilevel 65%, and ex vivo standard-needle 65%.
Episode counts are not independent specimen, animal, patient, platform, or site counts. Specimen sourcing and repeated-use dependence are unreported.
R1 is supported separately for simulation, phantoms, and ex vivo porcine tissue. Synthetic holdouts do not establish R2; bench execution does not establish R6; human annotation does not establish R4.
Patient benefit, workload reduction, in vivo feasibility, tissue-injury rates, contact-force guarantees, and comparative clinical effectiveness are not demonstrated.
Workspace restriction and startup idle are narrowly scoped safeguards. Post-actuation correction does not establish prevention of contact during the preceding move; Zsafe is unreported.
Ruler-distance and mask-IoU evaluations concern perception, not future-state fidelity. SAM-assisted reference masks lack reported independent adjudication.
All raw legacy cells remain unchanged historical content. Proposed corrections and qualified assertions do not overwrite them.
Source mathematical ambiguities, table aggregation, and approximate visual plot readings remain queued.
